title: Help
author: ConfidenceDry581
selftext: Hello everyone, I have been working on building a profitable automated meme coin trading bot for months now. All of the bots functions work but my strategies do not. I have tried four different strategies now and every one loses sol. Would anyone be willing to help me with getting a profitable strategy, i’m tired of losing money.

comments.author: CardiologistFun8185
comments.body:
This is risky with meme coins where some strategies will rely on positive news releases etc, however with meme coins you'll often be basing strategy decisions on "pump" news, potentially fake, at least hyped up.

Im not able to help directly but interested to see how it plays out and whether you can find a genuine and stable strategy

comments.body: Do you seriously think someone is going to tell you a profitable strategy? Why would they do that?
